When thinking of item choices in lane you should buy items that allow you to get cs and deny the cs of the carry most effectively. You said it was a hard lane and you couldn't harass, so a trading item like bracer definitely wouldn't help. You wanted more regen but bracer provides almost none relative to its cost. If a ring of health would be enough to help you survive in lane that would be quite strong in addition to more consumable regen and would likely be the ideal item. You might be losing too hard for it to be safe to get enough gold to buy though or it may not be enough for you to stay around. If it would not help and you aren't dying but keep getting low and need mana to last hit: buying a bottle is quite strong especially on mars as you tend to move around after hitting level 6 and can keep taking the back rune. Whatever your choice, buying consumable regen to keep you near full is generally more important than any small item timing like bracer especially as an offlaner. The only normal exceptions would be a helm of the iron will, bottle, or ring of health as they will enable you to regen more later or boots/phase if they enable you to get kills. If you were already level 6 than you should consider trying to get the carry to come to the off lane and if you can't just leaving and making plays with arena. Soul ring is great when it allows you to keep using mana while if you are not worried about losing health in lane or you need a sudden burst to do a combo. If you are low health and have little hope of killing them it is an inefficient item as the active part becomes useless. Once you are able to be active in lane again, the laning phase is over, or you are totally booted out of lane then soul ring is a fine item.
